title: Grade 4 CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — General Assessment #12

pages.quiz:
CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #12
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What does the story of Samson mainly show? (1 mark)
   A. God's power
   B. The size of Timnah
   C. The wealth of Philistines
   D. The power of lions

2. What do we ask when we say "forgive us our debts"? (1 mark)
   A. Forgiveness of our sins
   B. Bread
   C. Money
   D. A gift

3. What name did the angel tell Mary to give her son? (1 mark)
   A. Emmanuel only
   B. John
   C. Gabriel
   D. Jesus

4. Which verse says that the fear of the Lord is the beginning of knowledge? (1 mark)
   A. John 3:16
   B. Acts 2:38
   C. Proverbs 1:7
   D. Luke 1:37

5. Which New Testament book tells how the early church began? (1 mark)
   A. Acts
   B. Hebrews
   C. Romans
   D. Luke

6. Which city did Abram come from? (1 mark)
   A. Jerusalem
   B. Ur
   C. Jericho
   D. Nazareth

7. Which is the best way to give? (1 mark)
   A. Laughing
   B. Cheerfully and respectfully
   C. Boasting
   D. Grumbling

8. Which lesson do we learn from Balaam? (1 mark)
   A. Follow money
   B. Curse enemies
   C. Ignore God
   D. Obey God and speak only what He says

9. Which verse mentions activities such as a hymn and a word of instruction? (1 mark)
   A. Genesis 1:1
   B. Luke 1:37
   C. John 3:16
   D. 1 Corinthians 14:26

10. Which is a sin? (1 mark)
   A. Praying
   B. Stealing
   C. Helping
   D. Sharing

11. Which of these is a result of revenge? (1 mark)
   A. Friendship grows
   B. Everyone is safe
   C. Peace grows
   D. The problem gets bigger

12. What did Bartimaeus do after he could see? (1 mark)
   A. He ran to the temple
   B. He followed Jesus
   C. He went home to sleep
   D. He sold his cloak

13. What does planting trees do for God's creation? (1 mark)
   A. Harms the soil
   B. Kills birds
   C. Cares for the environment
   D. Wastes water

14. What did the seven fat cows stand for? (1 mark)
   A. Seven kings
   B. Seven rivers
   C. Seven years of famine
   D. Seven years of plenty

15. The steps to a right decision are stop, think, pray and choose. Which step comes after thinking? (1 mark)
   A. Pray
   B. Choose before praying
   C. Forget the problem
   D. Ask no one

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. Explain how Genesis 1:27 and Psalm 139 help a child who feels unimportant. (5 marks)

17. Why is being joyful important for a Christian? Give three reasons. (3 marks)

18. Explain how Jesus and Joseph are examples of forgiveness. (3 marks)

19. State two promises that God made to Abram in Genesis 12:1-3. (2 marks)

20. Name two personal items and one way of caring for each. (2 marks)
pages.answers:
CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #12 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. A — God's power
   The Spirit of the Lord gave Samson strength.

2. A — Forgiveness of our sins
   Debts stands for sins.

3. D — Jesus
   Luke 1:31 says to call Him Jesus.

4. C — Proverbs 1:7
   Proverbs 1:7 says this.

5. A — Acts
   The Acts of the Apostles tells the story of the early church.

6. B — Ur
   Abram was born in Ur of the Chaldeans.

7. B — Cheerfully and respectfully
   Kind giving respects the person.

8. D — Obey God and speak only what He says
   Balaam had to speak only God's words.

9. D — 1 Corinthians 14:26
   1 Corinthians 14:26 lists activities in worship.

10. B — Stealing
   Stealing is taking what is not yours.

11. D — The problem gets bigger
   Revenge starts a cycle of hurting.

12. B — He followed Jesus
   Mark 10:52 says he followed Jesus along the road.

13. C — Cares for the environment
   Trees give shade, fruit and homes for birds.

14. D — Seven years of plenty
   Joseph explained that they were seven good years.

15. A — Pray
   After thinking, we pray, and then we choose.

SECTION B
----
16. (5 marks)
   Answer: Genesis 1:27 says people are made in God's image, so every person is valuable. Psalm 139 says we are fearfully and wonderfully made, so God took great care in making us. God also knows us by name. Therefore no child is unimportant, and we should respect ourselves and others.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for Genesis 1:27 meaning, 1 for Psalm 139 meaning, 1 for God knowing us by name, 1 for the conclusion, 1 for a clear link to the child's feelings.

17. (3 marks)
   Answer: It keeps us healthy in mind; it cheers others; it helps us face problems; it shows trust in God. Any three.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid reason.

18. (3 marks)
   Answer: Jesus prayed for those who crucified Him. Joseph forgave his brothers and cared for them.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for Jesus, 1 for Joseph, 1 for what each did.

19. (2 marks)
   Answer: To make him a great nation, to bless him, to make his name great, and to bless all peoples through him.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid promise.

20. (2 marks)
   Answer: Uniform: wash it; exercise book: cover it.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each item with care.
